title: NTFS file records pile up while an AI desktop app runs
explanation: Several people measured the non-paged kernel pool growing, from a few MB to gigabytes an hour, most of it NTFS records (pool tag NtFC), while the Codex desktop app or a Code-tab session of the Claude desktop app runs, with Cowork idle. The cause traced so far is a bug in bindflt.sys, the filter behind a Store app's AppData: an open through a junction or link under AppData, from the app or any program it starts, leaves a reparse-point record behind. Programs started from a normal terminal leave none.
workaround: PoolWatch has no sure fix for this, and no cache clear frees these records. What helped others: making the app's data folders ordinary folders instead of junctions to another drive, the steps in the note on links under AppData, and running big jobs from a normal terminal. Only a Restart frees what has built up: a Shut down with Fast Startup on keeps it.
